findings.summary: StratifiedKFold splits on visit rows, so the same patient can appear in both train and test folds, causing patient-level leakage that inflates PR-AUC; should use StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by patient ID.

judge.reason: Same defect: row-level StratifiedKFold leaks patients across folds; recommends StratifiedGroupKFold by patient.

findings.label: hit
